findings.text: panels() rewrites only the `figure` and `drawn_plasma_mesh` keys of the receipt, so the `vacuum_saddle_validation` block the new assertions read at tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:39 exists only as hand-inserted JSON written by vacuum_null_probe.py and record_vacuum_probe.py in the run directory, which are not in the tree; the test can detect the block being edited or dropped but no committed code can regenerate it, the same run-directory-only evidence dependency the node was dispatched to remove.

the hollow cross is drawn at the six-neighbour census grid marker (1.818125, 0.0), which each receipt's own vacuum_saddle_validation records 4.5 mm from the polished root (1.813582, 9.0e-05), and neither the receipt nor tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:39-60 binds the drawn coordinate to the polished one, so the 'confirmed in-wall root' assertion confirms the field contains a saddle rather than that the glyph marks it.
